summary: Iteration 164: Comprehensive quality overhaul testing of naukri_regex_parser.py for Claude-level extraction quality. All 35 new tests passed (100%). Verified: Skills extraction anchored to LINE START (prevents matching 'key skills' inside sentences), CORE COMPETENCIES as primary skills source, _clean_skill() garbage filter (rejects conjunctions, Proficient/Adept/Demonstrated starters, >5 words, lowercase gerunds), Profile Summary capped at ~500 chars with sentence-boundary cut, Summary stops at CORE COMPETENCIES/Areas of Expertise boundary, |||| bar artifacts removed, CTC patterns (INR/Rs./Compensation/Package), Expected CTC patterns (Exp CTC/Looking for/Desired CTC), Notice period from header, Address filtering regression, Work experience boundary (Project Manager not truncating), Format A/B/C regressions. All 150 previous tests (iterations 158-163) also pass.

✅ CORE COMPETENCIES section recognized as primary skills source (Strategy 1)

✅ Profile Summary capped at ~500 chars with sentence-boundary cut (not 2000+ chars)
✅ Profile Summary stops at CORE COMPETENCIES / Areas of Expertise boundary
✅ Profile Summary removes '||||' bar artifacts from Naukri
✅ CTC extraction: ₹ X Lacs, INR X Lacs, INR X Cr, Rs. X Lacs, Compensation: X LPA, Package: Rs X Lacs
✅ Expected CTC: expects ₹ X Lacs, Expected CTC: X LPA, Exp CTC: X Lacs, Looking for X Lacs, Desired CTC: X Lacs
✅ Notice period from header: 3 Months pattern between company-since-date and Highest Qualification
✅ Address filtering regression: 'Residence Add.' never in employer/work exp
✅ Work experience boundary: 'Project Manager' designation does NOT truncate section
✅ Format A (pipe 'Title | Company') regression - still works
✅ Format B ('Title at Company') regression - still works
✅ Format C (date-anchored dense text) regression - still works
✅ Admin routes to regex parser (zero LLM cost)
